mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moment (uid, content, media, location, lat, lng, created_at) VALUES (#{uid}, #{content}, #{media}, #{location}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{createdAt})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moment_like (moment_id, uid) VALUES (#{momentId}, #{uid}) ON CONFLICT (moment_id, uid) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM moment_like WHERE moment_id = #{momentId} AND uid = #{uid}
